newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Tuesday amid low demand from textile mills, dealers at the private Karachi Cotton Association said.
However, prices fluctuated slightly in the kerb market, where mills with ready cash bought at rates lower than those prevailing at the KCA, broker Khushi Ram said.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 variety was quoted at 2,100/2,250 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), K-68 at 2,450/2,475 and MNH-93 at 2,460/2,485, the broker said.
Prices are likely to open unchanged on Wednesday, he said.
